inspirations.feedback_summary:
DRAWING FAILURE, not a verdict on the design: the render could not be drawn faithfully to the mechanism sketch after 3 rounds. Differences in the last round: Vs sketch: folding wheel arms missing (fixed brackets only); callout leaders misplaced/duplicated (Narrow Kerf Chain to hoses, Steep Wedge Hopper to soil stream, duplicate Tilt Screw Discharge and Rigid Grouser Wheels); battery packs not identifiable (unlabeled deck boxes). Ladder now has chute over hopper (improved) with functional gravity gap, chassis-ladder-hopper mounts otherwise match sketch connections.
Regions:
- arm (box [145.0, 680.0, 380.0, 835.0]): observed only short fixed vertical brackets above grouser wheels under chassis, no folding/diagonal arms; expected folding wheel arms (qty 4) supporting wheels, arms chassis to wheels, to widen track
- callout (box [228.0, 503.0, 360.0, 625.0]): observed leader ends on black hoses/cables on chassis deck mid-frame, not on trench chain; expected Narrow Kerf Chain leader to end on vertical chain in trench at bottom center
- callout (box [735.0, 268.0, 868.0, 300.0]): observed leader ends on falling soil stream above hopper, not hopper steel body; expected Steep Wedge Hopper leader to end on hopper body
- callout (box [596.0, 605.0, 734.0, 637.0]): observed two identical Tilt Screw Discharge labels; lower ends on hopper side panel, upper ends near outlet - duplicate and misplaced; expected single Tilt Screw Discharge label ending on screw outlet at hopper rear
- callout (box [15.0, 639.0, 148.0, 672.0]): observed two identical Rigid Grouser Wheels labels; upper leader ends on left soil pile, not wheel; expected single Rigid Grouser Wheels label ending on wheel
- battery (box [280.0, 580.0, 430.0, 630.0]): observed unlabeled black boxes/cables on deck, no identifiable 2 packs; expected 2 lithium phosphate battery packs on chassis, fused bus to dig and cameras
Decide whether the design is under-specified (say what the council must specify) or whether this says nothing about the design.
inspirations.why_useful: Retain as mechanism inspiration despite could_not_draw status. Failure is explicitly DRAWING FAILURE not design verdict: folding wheel arms rendered as fixed brackets, duplicated/misplaced callout leaders, unlabeled deck battery boxes. Core chassis-ladder-hopper mounts match sketch and chute-over-hopper with functional gravity gap improved. Narrow-kerf bucket-ladder + steep wedge hopper + tilt screw-metered discharge + rigid grouser wheels + LiFePO4 bus concept remains legible. Decision: this says nothing about the design, no council respec required.

concepts.text: inclined bucket-ladder digging chain with 8 buckets on chain driven by motor, plunges ~200 mm into bed — proven Lunabotics winner (Chondrobot-2 mined 8 kg BP-1 in 1 min; Alabama MARTE ladder plunged 8 in)

concepts.text: inclined bucket-ladder chain that both loosens and elevates soil into hopper in one motion, buckets empty over top sprocket by gravity into chute

concepts.text: transverse milling drum loosener (distant analogy from rotary trencher/tiller): small powered drum across front milling 50 mm deep by 300 mm wide with teeth throwing loosened BP-1 back onto collection conveyor — rotary tiller breaks soil by rotation so forward draft stays small unlike drag blade; maps to low traction budget and feeds bucket-ladder or belt
concepts.author: Mobility and Deployable Chassis Lead

concepts.text: high rear-pivot dump body with extended overhang (distant analogy from farm dump trailer): hopper pivots behind rear axle and lifts outlet to 0.55 m so pour clears 0.40 m bin lip with 0.15 m gap, soil slides by gravity plus vibration; maps trailer tipping rule that raised load behind axle sets tip moment to this robot rear pour
concepts.author: Mobility and Deployable Chassis Lead

concepts.text: autonomous current-limited dig control (distant analogy from mining excavator stall-avoidance): ladder/drum feed rate auto-reduced when motor current exceeds threshold, backs out on stall, maps excavator hoist/crowd stall avoidance to blind BP-1 digging without operator feel
concepts.author: Autonomy and Blind Operations Lead

concepts.text: fiducial-guided auto-align dump (distant analogy from drone precision landing on visual pad / AGV dock): mast camera measures pose to bin AprilTag fiducial, robot creeps to aligned stance then tilts, maps landing-pad relative navigation to blind pour into bin without operator depth perception
concepts.author: Autonomy and Blind Operations Lead

concepts.text: eccentric-mass vibratory cutting edge on scraper/ladder foot (distant analogy from vibratory pile driver and concrete vibrator): small counter-rotating eccentric motor shakes cutting edge at tens of Hz to fluidize BP-1 contact so draft stays below traction on same power bus; maps pile-driver friction reduction to light robot draft limit
concepts.author: Power Structure and Integration Lead

concepts.text: narrow-kerf trenching chain loosener (distant analogy from ditch-witch ride-on trencher): 100 mm wide vertical chain cuts 50 mm deep slot like a chainsaw kerf, spoil falls sideways for ladder buckets to collect — narrow kerf cuts draft to one-third of full-width blade and maps trencher spoil-row to light-robot traction limit
concepts.author: Excavation and Regolith Handling Lead

concepts.text: auger-assisted live-bottom discharge (distant analogy from grain combine unloading auger): short screw conveyor in hopper floor meters BP-1 to rear outlet during tilt so pour is controlled not slumping, maps combine metered unloading to blind pour accuracy over bin lip
